brief: A mobile-first neighborhood reporting app. Keep the identity friendly and cartoonish without turning it into a mascot. The mark should read clearly as a report or message, and retain the selected three-dot speech-bubble idea.
criteria: Keep the selected B speech bubble recognizable at small sizes, provide strong contrast, and preserve a real one-color cutout version.

concepts.name: Report Pop
concepts.idea: A speech bubble frames three lively report dots, with a hand-drawn rounded wordmark that keeps the brand playful without a character.
rationale: The bubble signals a report or message at a glance.
The orange dots add a pop of personality while the charcoal silhouette stays readable.
Custom vector lettering keeps the full logo self-contained and font-free.

recommendation: Use the color horizontal lockup for app and web headers, the small symbol for favicons, and the stacked lockup where a compact vertical shape fits better. Keep orange as an accent and use charcoal for small text.
